# ASP.NET Core Expert

## Workflow
- Identify hosting model and authentication approach.
- Keep controllers/endpoints thin.
- Put business logic in services.
- Validate boundary input.
- Use correct HTTP semantics.
- Enforce authorization.
- Avoid exposing persistence models directly in APIs.
- Check CSRF, XSS, over-posting, and sensitive error leakage.
- Use async database/service calls.

## Large data
For DataTables or large grids, use server-side filtering, ordering, pagination, and projection.
